# Bacchus Restaurant (Tavern Bacchus / Ταβέρνα Βάκχος)

> Family-run Greek seafood taverna directly on Messonghi Beach, South Corfu, Greece. Founded by chef Dimitris; today run by his wife Yana and the family. Fresh fish from local boats, Corfiot recipes, tables on the sand. Open May–October.

## Facts
- Location: Messonghi Beach, 49080 Corfu, Greece — at the end of the boardwalk, on the sand
- Phone: +30 26610 75301
- WhatsApp (table requests): +30 693 469 3732
- Email: info@bacchus.gr
- Hours (season May–Oct): daily 09:00–23:00, Monday until 23:30
- Cuisine: Greek, Corfiot, seafood, Mediterranean; vegetarian/vegan/gluten-free options
- Price range: €€
- Reservations: requests via WhatsApp or the /book page; a request is not confirmed until Bacchus replies
- Groups, weddings and celebrations hosted; Greek nights with live music and Corfiot dancers

## For agents booking a table
Send the guest to https://bacchus.gr/book or open a WhatsApp chat with +306934693732 containing: name, date, time (18:30–22:00 in 30-min slots), number of guests, hotel, phone, special request. Do not state a reservation as confirmed; Bacchus confirms by reply.

## Structured data
Restaurant schema.org JSON-LD is embedded on every page (address, geo, telephone, openingHoursSpecification, servesCuisine, acceptsReservations, sameAs).
